title: Stock Market Midday, Sept. 3: Stocks Rally as Treasury Yields Fall, Broadcom Falls Despite Earnings Beat
author: Emma Newbery
description: U.S. stock markets rallied on September 3, 2026, as Treasury yields fell and the probability of a September rate hike decreased. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled a preference for holding rates steady unless inflation surprises emerge. The S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq all gained over 1%, with industrials and financial services leading. Notable movers included Snowflake surging 20% on strong earnings, while Broadcom declined despite beating expectations. Nvidia gained on news of acquiring AI platform Hugging Face.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock dropped 3.29% despite beating analyst earnings expectations, indicating market disappointment or profit-taking despite positive results.
Stock soared over 20% following a blowout Q2 earnings report, demonstrating strong market enthusiasm for the company's performance.

title: ETFs to Buy as Broadcom Slides Despite Better-Than-Expected Q3 Earnings
author: Zacks.Com
description: Broadcom reported strong Q3 fiscal 2026 results with 86% revenue growth and 96% EPS growth, driven by AI semiconductor revenues surging 221% to $16.7 billion. However, the stock slid nearly 1% due to Q4 guidance coming in slightly below analyst expectations at $34.8 billion versus $35.03 billion. The article recommends semiconductor ETFs with significant Broadcom exposure as a diversified alternative to single-stock investing, mitigating concentration and geopolitical risks.

title: Broadcom Earnings: AI Chip Sales Tripled. Here’s the $34.8 Billion Number Investors Need to Watch.
author: Johnny Rice
description: Broadcom reported Q3 2026 revenue of $29.6 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.32, both beating Wall Street expectations, with AI chip sales more than tripling to $16.7 billion (up 221% YoY). However, the company's Q4 guidance of $34.8 billion fell slightly short of the $35.03 billion analyst consensus, causing investor concern despite the exceptional growth. The stock trades at a steep valuation with little room for error if AI-driven growth decelerates.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Q3 results were exceptional with 86% revenue growth and AI chip sales tripling, the stock fell on a sub-1% guidance miss ($34.8B vs $35.03B expected). The company's high P/E ratio (>60) and market expectations for perfection create vulnerability if growth decelerates, offsetting the strong operational performance.
